$description: Semantic colour roles. These are what components should use; primitives are never referenced from component CSS. Light theme only for now (Figma has a single mode).

muted.$description: Placeholders, captions, meta text. Was neutral/700 (4.2:1 on white); neutral/650 passes AA (5.3:1)

link.$description: Links. blue/600 is 4.0:1 on white and fails AA; blue/650 fails on grey and pale-blue surfaces; blue/700 passes on every surface (6.6:1 or better)

iio.note: Accessibility remedy. The products still use blue/600 for links

brand.$description: Emphasised brand text, e.g. top result title, avatar

danger.$description: Error and destructive text on white and grey surfaces (5.3:1 or better)

danger-on-tint.$description: Error text on the pale red tint (surface/danger). red/650 is 4.35:1 there, red/700 is 5.9:1

hover.$description: Row and secondary-button hover; prose background

brand-wash.$description: Page background behind the mobile device frame

brand.$description: Chip borders (web used #d1e4ff, snapped to blue/100)

input.$description: Input and search bar outlines. Needs 3:1 against the page (WCAG 1.4.11); border/default is 1.4:1

iio.note: For outlined fields. The app's search bars and text fields use the Material 3 layer (filled search bar, m3 outline on text fields), so no product uses this yet

primary-accessible.$description: Fill for primary buttons that carry text: white on blue/650 is 5.1:1, on blue/600 it is 4.0:1

iio.note: Adopted in both products (2026-09-29). Text-bearing primary fills use this; brand blue/600 stays for icons, borders and focus

third-party-ph.$description: Product Hunt brand colour; not an internet.io colour
